Bank.intro: Headroom reads your balances and transactions to build your 13-week forecast.

Bank.passwordTitle: Your password stays with your bank
Bank.passwordBody: You log in on your bank's own screen. Headroom never sees your password.

Bank.provider: Bank connections are provided by Plaid.

Accounts.title: Which accounts count as cash?
Accounts.introOne: {bank} is connected. Choose what Headroom counts as cash you can spend.
Accounts.introMany: Your banks are connected. Choose what Headroom counts as cash you can spend.
Accounts.spendQuestion: Is this money you can spend?
Accounts.creditNote: Credit never counts as cash. Headroom shows what's available, and may suggest it as a fix.
Accounts.otherNote: This type of account can't count as cash.
Accounts.currencyNote: Only Canadian dollar accounts can count as cash for now.
Accounts.primaryNote: Expected payments you add go to your primary account unless you choose another.
